title: Covid Sample Prep with Custom 96 Tube Rack
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Mount needle at position 10
steps.instruction: Place the pipette needle into the instrument slot designated as position 10.

steps.title: Aspirate 50 µL from source tubes
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel pipette (mounted on the left or right as specified), aspirate 50 µL from each source tube (each tube contains 5 mL) in column order (A1, B1, C1 … H1, A2 …) for the defined number of samples (1–96).

substeps.instruction: Select the P300 single‑channel mount (left or right) according to the protocol parameter.
Aspirate 50 µL from each 5 mL sample tube in the specified column sequence.

steps.title: Dispense 50 µL into plate with blowout
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated 50 µL into the matching well of a standard BIORAD 96‑well plate, maintaining the same column order, and perform a blowout after each dispense.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 50 µL into the corresponding well.
Execute a blowout to ensure complete delivery.

steps.title: Discard needle in trash
steps.instruction: Eject and discard the used needle into the designated waste container.
